title: Repair and Emergency Service Calls — Repair Guarantee and Free Return Visits
content:
## Guarantee clause

1. **Periods.** Under Repair and Emergency Service Calls, labor on every completed repair is guaranteed for the class's repair guarantee period. A Harbison-supplied part is guaranteed for the class's parts guarantee period. Both run from the completion date of the call that performed the repair.
2. **Free return visit.** A return visit is free under the repair guarantee only when it is booked no later than the class's repair guarantee days after the original repair was completed.
3. **Counting.** Guarantee days are counted as calendar days with the original completion date as day 0. A return visit booked on the last day qualifies. The original completion date is read from the original call's record.
4. **Member extension.** For a repair completed while the customer's Comfort Club agreement was active, the guarantee is extended by the repair guarantee extension of the member's tier. The extension is added as calendar months to the end of the guarantee.
5. **Booking the return visit.** The return visit is booked naming the original call as the call it returns to.
6. **What is free.** It is free only when the technician finds that the same task's part or workmanship has failed on the same unit. In that case the return visit's diagnostic fee, any premium and the repeated task's parts and labor are each offset by a recall no-charge discount naming the line.
7. **What is not free.** A different failure found on the return visit is billed normally. When the guaranteed repair has not failed, the diagnostic fee of the return visit stands.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical dates, 365-day guarantee)

| Original repair completed | Return visit booked | Count | Free return visit |
|---|---|---|---|
| 2 June 2025 (day 0) | 2 June 2026 | Day 365, the last day | Yes |
| 2 June 2025 (day 0) | 3 June 2026 | Day 366 | No |

With an illustrative member extension of 12 months on a repair completed while the agreement was active, the guarantee that ended on 2 June 2026 instead ends 12 calendar months later, on 2 June 2027.

## Outcomes on the return visit

| Technician finds | Return visit's diagnostic fee and premium | Repeated task's parts and labor | Other work |
|---|---|---|---|
| Same task's part or workmanship failed on the same unit | Offset by recall no-charge discounts | Offset by recall no-charge discounts | — |
| A different failure | Billed normally | — | Billed normally |
| The guaranteed repair has not failed | Diagnostic fee stands | — | — |
